repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-device
repository.purpose: Device registration for the Webex JS SDK: registers, refreshes, and unregisters this client's device with the WDM service and exposes the device-derived state (URLs, feature toggles, organization policy) as the webex.internal.device plugin.

device-plugin-sdk.summary: Published npm package surface declared by package.json (main: dist/index.js, devMain: src/index.js): the default Device plugin registered as webex.internal.device, the config namespace webex.config.device, constants, CatalogDetails, DeviceRegistrationOptions, DeviceUrlInterceptor, and the feature classes exported from src/index.js. Internal plugin: semantic versioning is not strictly followed. Per-export detail lives in the owning module spec Public surface.

device-registration-events.summary: Events on webex.internal.device: registration:success (name declared as DEVICE_EVENT_REGISTRATION_SUCCESS in src/constants.js, triggered in src/device.js), change and change:features (re-emitted by src/device.js), and change:<collection> for the developer, entitlement, and user feature collections (emitted by src/features/features-model.js; collection names declared in src/constants.js).

cisco-device-url-header.summary: cisco-device-url request header carrying the registered device URL, added by DeviceUrlInterceptor to outbound requests for catalog services other than idbroker, oauth, and saml.

wdm-device-registration-service.source: WDM service (Webex web device manager), reached through the wdm entry of the services catalog; no machine-readable contract is committed in this repository, and the response shape is exercised by the fixture test/unit/spec/wdm-dto.json
wdm-device-registration-service.summary: Device registration endpoints consumed by this module: POST wdm/devices to register, PUT and DELETE on the device url to refresh and unregister, and GET wdm/devices to list devices for cleanup.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; no module spec, so source was used: WebexPlugin, persist, waitForValue, registerInternalPlugin, services plugin)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Plugin host contract consumed by this module: the WebexPlugin base model, the persist and waitForValue decorators, registerInternalPlugin, webex.request, and the services methods waitForCatalog, get, waitForService, getServiceFromUrl, convertUrlToPriorityHostUrl, and markFailedUrl.

webex-common-sdk.source: @webex/common (workspace package; module spec consulted: oneFlight, deprecated, inBrowser, deviceType)
webex-common-sdk.summary: Shared primitives used here: oneFlight and deprecated decorators, the inBrowser flag, and the deviceType constants.

common-timers-sdk.summary: safeSetTimeout, a setTimeout wrapper that unrefs the handle, used for the ephemeral refresh timer, the logout timer, and the registration wait.

http-core-sdk.summary: The Interceptor base class extended by DeviceUrlInterceptor.

internal-plugin-metrics-sdk.source: @webex/internal-plugin-metrics (workspace package; no module spec, so source was used: newMetrics.submitInternalEvent, newMetrics.callDiagnosticMetrics.setDeviceInfo, metrics.submitClientMetrics)
internal-plugin-metrics-sdk.summary: Metrics plugin API called during registration for internal events, call-diagnostic device info, and client metrics.
